explanation: The sharp bound R_k(T) ≤ k(n-2) + 2 for trees on n ≥ 2 vertices, attained by stars, follows from the Erdős–Sós theorem by pigeonhole. The docstring calls it a theorem; this is supported now that erdosproblems.com/548 records a full proof. A Lean proof is linked. Consistent with erdosproblems.com/557. Faithful.
